approved_target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups
approved_target.intended_effect_measure: Between-group difference in change in overall Cannabis Withdrawal Scale severity over time

measurement.method: Overall severity of cannabis withdrawal measured by the 19-item Cannabis Withdrawal Scale, with each item rated 0–10 for the previous 24 hours.

reported_result.analysis_population: All 51 randomized participants (27 nabiximols, 24 placebo); intention-to-treat analysis; missing CWS questionnaires were multiply imputed in 5 datasets.

selection_basis: Parallel 51-person trial; available 11-page main and 6-page supplement; source-reported numeric primary overall withdrawal F=2.39. No Domain/reference labels used for selection. Target treatment days 1–6 versus reported repeated model days 1–9 retained as source/target limitation.
guard_authorization: Explicit parent instruction: one known-case completion check at b54db92, 5M total input; retain 200k uncached/15k output/60 tools/20min wall/3min idle/four saves per domain. No invocation retry or second case.
qualification: Known-case delivery mechanism check. Original source/target identical to previous paid Allsop case, no prior Domain answers exposed. Not unseen validation. Model owns complete D1–D5, review and finalization.
